question: portal says tenant committed but quota dot never turns green, tenant never ready
rubric: tenant_status() in app.py polls the ResourceQuota named <tenant>-quota (and the ANP tenant-<name>); the template resourcequota.yaml produces exactly that name; if names differ or ArgoCD has not synced (3 min poll) the dot stays waiting. Also acceptable: the SA lacks get on resourcequotas.

question: clicking Create tenant does nothing, browser shows HTTP 415 unsupported media type
rubric: do_POST in app.py returns 415 unless Content-Type starts with application/json (CSRF guard); the page's api() in index.html must send that header on POST; a proxy or a changed fetch() dropping the header causes it.

question: tenant editors were able to open their namespace to every other namespace with a NetworkPolicy
rubric: Editors hold the built-in edit ClusterRole (rolebinding-edit.yaml) which allows creating NetworkPolicies; isolation is meant to be enforced by the cluster-scoped AdminNetworkPolicy (adminnetworkpolicy.yaml) whose Deny rule tenants cannot override; if it was bypassed, the ANP is missing, not synced, or the toggles emitted Pass instead of Deny.

question: OpenShift login loop, oauth redirect to the portal route is rejected
rubric: The ServiceAccount in rbac.yaml carries the serviceaccounts.openshift.io/oauth-redirectreference annotation pointing at Route tenant-portal; oauth-proxy in deployment.yaml uses --openshift-service-account=tenant-portal; a mismatch in SA name, Route name, or a missing annotation/cookie secret causes the loop.

question: CI pipeline validate-chart fails with no AdminNetworkPolicy rendered
rubric: The validate-chart job greps the rendered output for 'name: tenant-<file>' produced by adminnetworkpolicy.yaml; it fails when tenant.name in the tenant file does not equal the file name, or the template did not render (bad YAML / missing keys).

question: removed a tenant file from git and want to be sure ArgoCD will not delete the namespace
rubric: Every rendered resource carries argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: Prune=false,Delete=false (namespace.yaml and the other templates); the Application in bootstrap/tenant-provisioning.yaml has automated prune true but the annotation wins; the namespace stays and the app shows OutOfSync until deleted by hand.

question: portal returns 502 GitLab refused the commit HTTP 403
rubric: commit_tenant() in app.py POSTs to /repository/commits on the protected main branch using GITLAB_TOKEN from the tenant-portal-gitlab Secret mounted in deployment.yaml; 403 means the project access token lacks Maintainer role or api scope, or is expired.

question: which secret does the oauth-proxy serve for TLS and who issues it
rubric: Secret tenant-portal-tls, issued and renewed by the OpenShift service CA via the service.beta.openshift.io/serving-cert-secret-name annotation on the Service; mounted at /etc/tls/private in the oauth-proxy container.

question: helm install fails: anpPriority nil pointer for a hand written tenant file
rubric: adminnetworkpolicy.yaml reads $v.network.anpPriority after mergeOverwrite of values.yaml with the tenant file; a hand-written file whose network: block is present but omits anpPriority still inherits 50 from values.yaml, so nil means values.yaml lost the key or the tenant file set network: to a scalar/null.

question: existing tenants list shows could not load
rubric: loadTenants() in index.html calls GET /api/tenants; do_GET in app.py returns 401 without X-Forwarded-User or 502 when list_tenants() fails the GitLab tree lookup (token missing/invalid, wrong GITLAB_PROJECT).

question: portal rejects a namespace name that starts with openshift as reserved prefix, where is that rule
rubric: Both validate() in app.py (server) and validate() in index.html (client) reject names starting with openshift or kube- or equal to default; changing the rule requires editing both.

question: how do I make ArgoCD pick up a new tenant faster than three minutes
rubric: ArgoCD polls every three minutes by default; docs/tenant-portal.md describes adding a GitLab push webhook to https://<argocd route>/api/webhook; the Application in bootstrap/tenant-provisioning.yaml is the one that syncs charts/tenant.

question: GPU quota is not applied to the tenant namespace even though gpu is set in the tenant file
rubric: resourcequota.yaml emits requests.nvidia.com/gpu only when quota.requests.gpu (as string) is not "0"; check the tenant file value and quoting; talha-llm.yaml sets gpu: "2" as the working example.

question: I edited portal/app/app.py and committed but the running portal did not change
rubric: The portal is not managed by ArgoCD; app.py is served from the tenant-portal-app ConfigMap generated by configMapGenerator in kustomization.yaml with a content hash; you must re-run oc apply -k portal, which rolls the Deployment because the ConfigMap name changes.

question: CI job fails with permission denied while helm writes its cache
rubric: Job pods run as a random non-root UID under OpenShift restricted SCC (gitlab-runner.yaml comments); .gitlab-ci.yml sets HOME and HELM_CACHE_HOME/HELM_CONFIG_HOME/HELM_DATA_HOME to /tmp so that user can write; the failure means those variables were removed or an image ignores them.
